issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the king David finished/ceased going out to Absalom' (וַתְּכַל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ לָצֵאת אֶל אַבְשָׁלוֹם), meaning he stopped going out to meet/pursue Absalom. The Chinese adds '追捕' (pursue/capture), which is not in the Hebrew; the Hebrew only says 'going out to Absalom' without specifying pursuit or capture.
